summary: Eighteen days of mid-range Botswana safari for two: Maun and the Okavango by mokoro and game drive, Makgadikgadi pans by road, then Kasane and Chobe — with a Victoria Falls day trip. Bases in town and lodge day trips, not luxury fly-in camps.

days.title: Late arrival in Gaborone
days.travelHack: Book an airport hotel transfer in advance — late arrivals mean limited public transport.
days.transportationTips: Sir Seretse Khama (GBE) to city hotels: pre-booked transfer ~30–45 min.
days.localWarnings: After a late arrival, keep the evening light — safari starts tomorrow.

evening.name: Arrival at GBE and hotel transfer
evening.description: Land from Munich, collect luggage, and transfer to an airport-area hotel.
bullets: Expect landing around 20:40.
Pre-booked transfer is simplest after dark.

evening.name: Check-in and rest
evening.description: Settle in and rest before the domestic hop to Maun tomorrow.
bullets: Light snack if needed — save energy for the delta.
Confirm tomorrow's GBE→MUB flight times tonight.

days.title: Fly to Maun and optional scenic flight
days.travelHack: Optional scenic flight over the Okavango is best booked in Maun — morning light if weather allows.
days.transportationTips: Domestic GBE→MUB ~1h30. In Maun, lodges and operators run shuttles; taxis for town.

morning.name: Domestic flight Gaborone to Maun
morning.description: Morning hop to Botswana's safari gateway on the Okavango.
bullets: Arrive at GBE 60–90 min before departure.
Window seat worth it for the approach over the delta fringe.

morning.name: Check-in and settle in Maun
morning.description: Transfer to lodge or guesthouse and drop bags before activities.
bullets: Most operators pick up from town hotels.
Confirm mokoro and game-drive times for the next days.

afternoon.name: Optional scenic flight over the Okavango
afternoon.description: Short fixed-wing circuit for a bird's-eye view of channels and islands — skip if budget is tight.
bullets: Book locally; ~45–60 min airborne.
Best in clear morning or late afternoon.

evening.name: Dinner by the Thamalakane River
evening.description: Relaxed riverside meal — Maun's easy intro before delta days.
bullets: Several lodges and restaurants line the river.
Early night — full mokoro day tomorrow.

days.title: Full-day mokoro in the Okavango Delta
days.travelHack: Pack a dry bag — mokoro polers may splash; sun hat and repellent essential.
days.transportationTips: Operator 4x4 to mokoro station, then poler-guided channels — typically half- to full-day.
days.localWarnings: Hippos and crocs are real — follow poler instructions at all times.

morning.name: Mokoro excursion into the delta
morning.description: Traditional dugout through papyrus channels — birds, lilies, and quiet water.
bullets: Includes guided poling and short island walks.
Mid-range day trip from Maun — not a fly-in camp.

afternoon.name: Delta walk and picnic lunch
afternoon.description: Guided bush walk on a delta island with a simple packed lunch.
bullets: Track and bird focus depending on season.
Return to Maun by late afternoon.

evening.name: Easy dinner in Maun
evening.description: Low-key meal after a long day on the water.
bullets: Hotel restaurant or town spot — no need to dress up.
Rehydrate and prep for tomorrow's free morning.

days.title: Free morning and village visit
days.travelHack: Use a slow morning to laundry, SIM card, and cash — ATMs can be finicky.
days.transportationTips: Village visits are usually short taxi or operator shuttle from town.

morning.name: Free morning in Maun
morning.description: Markets, curio shops, or pool time — recover before Moremi.
bullets: Grab supplies for upcoming road days.
Optional short riverside walk.

afternoon.name: Community village visit
afternoon.description: Guided look at local life outside the tourism bubble — crafts and culture.
bullets: Book through a reputable operator.
Buy crafts directly if you wish — cash helps.

evening.name: Dinner in town
evening.description: Casual meal before tomorrow's early Moremi departure.
bullets: Confirm pickup time tonight.
Pack neutral colours for game drive.

days.title: Full-day Moremi game drive
days.travelHack: Moremi day trips from Maun are long — leave early; park fees are included in most packages.
days.transportationTips: Full-day 4x4 from Maun (~2–3h each way with game viewing en route).
days.localWarnings: Stay in the vehicle except at designated stops.

morning.name: Moremi Game Reserve game drive
morning.description: Classic Botswana safari — elephant, antelope, predators if you're lucky.
bullets: Day trip base in Maun, not an overnight fly-in lodge.
Includes park fees and picnic lunch on most tours.

afternoon.name: Continued game viewing and return
afternoon.description: Afternoon loop through floodplains and mopane woodland before heading back.
bullets: Golden hour can be excellent for photography.
Expect back in Maun early evening.

evening.name: Recovery dinner
evening.description: Simple dinner after a dusty, rewarding safari day.
bullets: Early night recommended.
Boteti riverside tomorrow — lighter pace.

days.title: Boteti riverside and sunset cruise
days.travelHack: Boteti elephant viewing depends on water levels — ask locally what's active this week.
days.transportationTips: Half-day 4x4 to Boteti area; sunset cruise on Thamalakane in Maun.

morning.name: Boteti riverside wildlife viewing
morning.description: Morning at the Boteti fringe — elephants and riverine birds when water draws game.
bullets: Shorter outing than Moremi.
Good buffer before the pans drive.

afternoon.name: Free afternoon in Maun
afternoon.description: Rest, repack, or last-minute shopping before Makgadikgadi.
bullets: Check van transfer details for Nata.
Charge cameras and power banks.

evening.name: Thamalakane sunset cruise
evening.description: Relaxed boat ride with sundowners on the river.
bullets: Hippos possible — stay seated.
Book through lodge or local operator.

days.title: Rest day before the pans
days.travelHack: Treat this as a buffer — road days ahead are longer.
days.transportationTips: Light local errands only; confirm Nata pickup time.

morning.name: Slow morning and packing
morning.description: Sleep in, laundry, and prep for the drive to Makgadikgadi.
bullets: Snacks and water for tomorrow's van leg.
Neutral layers for hot days and cool pans nights.

afternoon.name: Optional riverside walk or pool
bullets: Good day to journal or edit photos.
Early dinner if you prefer.

evening.name: Light dinner
bullets: Confirm van pickup time and luggage limit.
Charge everything overnight.

days.title: Drive to Nata and bird sanctuary
days.travelHack: Maun→Nata is ~3h by van — sit up front if you get motion sick on corrugated roads.
days.transportationTips: Shared or private van Maun→Nata ~3h. Nata Bird Sanctuary is a short drive from town.
days.localWarnings: Carry water; stops are limited on the cross-country leg.

morning.name: Van transfer Maun to Nata
morning.description: Overland hop toward the Makgadikgadi pans — savanna and cattle country.
bullets: Depart early to beat midday heat.
Luggage in roof rack or trailer on shared transfers.

morning.name: Check-in near Nata
morning.description: Settle at lodge or campsite base for pans exploration.
bullets: Most bases are simple — mid-range, not luxury.
Confirm meerkat and pans tours for tomorrow.

afternoon.name: Nata Bird Sanctuary
afternoon.description: Seasonal flamingos and waterbirds when Sowa Pan holds water.
bullets: Best Nov–Apr depending on rains.
Short boardwalk and viewpoint loop.

evening.name: Dinner at lodge
evening.description: Simple lodge meal under wide pans skies.
bullets: Stars are excellent here — step outside after dinner.
Early start for meerkats tomorrow.

days.title: Pans exploration and meerkats
days.travelHack: Meerkat habituation walks start at dawn — wrap up warm; pans mornings are cold.
days.transportationTips: Full-day 4x4 or van from Nata/Gweta — no fly-in required.
days.localWarnings: No shade on the pans — hat, sunscreen, and water.

morning.name: Meerkat habituation walk
morning.description: Sit quietly near a habituated colony as they emerge to warm up.
bullets: Book with a licensed operator.
Keep distance — no touching or feeding.

afternoon.name: Makgadikgadi pans drive
afternoon.description: Vast salt pans and baobab fringe — surreal midday horizons.
bullets: 4x4 essential on the pan surface.
Classic photo stops at island outcrops.

evening.name: Camp or lodge dinner
evening.description: Return to base for a fireside meal.
bullets: Baines' Baobabs tomorrow.
Bring a headlamp for night walks to rooms.

days.title: Baines' Baobabs and stargazing
days.travelHack: Sunset at Baines' Baobabs is iconic — time the drive for golden hour.
days.transportationTips: Half- to full-day 4x4 from Nata/Gweta area.

morning.name: Drive to Baines' Baobabs
morning.description: Historic baobab cluster painted by Thomas Baines — remote and photogenic.
bullets: Allow half a day including transit.
Pack lunch unless operator provides.

afternoon.name: Pans photography and exploration
afternoon.description: Open salt crust, mirages, and endless horizons.
bullets: Tripod useful for sunset shots.
Stay on established tracks.

evening.name: Stargazing on the pans
evening.description: Some operators offer night drives or simple sky-watching away from light pollution.
bullets: Milky Way season is strong in spring.
Wrap up — nights get cold.

days.title: Gweta market and craft workshop
days.travelHack: Gweta is the pans hub — good for crafts and a lower-cost day between safari outings.
days.transportationTips: Short taxi or lodge shuttle to Gweta village.

morning.name: Gweta village market
morning.description: Local market for produce, basics, and everyday Botswana life.
bullets: Cash is king.
Photograph people only with permission.

afternoon.name: Craft workshop visit
afternoon.description: Basket weaving or pottery demo with local artisans.
bullets: Buy direct if you find something you like.
Supports community projects.

evening.name: Simple lodge dinner
evening.description: Quiet evening before the last full pans day.
bullets: Prep for long drive to Kasane in two days.
Repack safari gear.

days.title: Easy morning and last pans evening
days.travelHack: Optional short revisit to a favourite pan spot — don't over-schedule before Kasane.
days.transportationTips: Light local outings only; confirm Kasane van for tomorrow or day after.

morning.name: Relaxed morning
morning.description: Sleep in, pool if available, or short walk around camp.
bullets: Charge devices for the long transfer.
Snacks for the road tomorrow.

afternoon.name: Optional short pans outing
afternoon.description: Repeat a favourite viewpoint or baobab stop if energy allows.
bullets: Skip if you prefer rest.
Sunset can be as good as sunrise here.

evening.name: Last pans sunset
evening.description: Final wide-open horizon before heading north to Chobe.
bullets: Bring a jacket.
Pack tonight for Nata→Kasane drive.

days.title: Drive to Kasane and Chobe sunset cruise
days.travelHack: Nata→Kasane is ~5h30 — break at Nata or Pandamatenga; book Chobe cruise for late afternoon.
days.transportationTips: Van Nata→Kasane ~5h30. Chobe river cruises depart from Kasane waterfront.
days.localWarnings: Long travel day — hydrate and stretch at stops.

morning.name: Van transfer Nata to Kasane
morning.description: Overland leg to Chobe — border forests and elephant country.
bullets: Early start recommended.
Border formalities possible depending on route.

morning.name: Check-in in Kasane
morning.description: Settle at riverside lodge or guesthouse.
bullets: Confirm tomorrow's game drive slot.
Victoria Falls day trip often booked from here.

evening.name: Chobe sunset river cruise
evening.description: Boat safari on the Chobe — elephant, hippo, and croc at the water's edge.
bullets: Sunset departures are popular — book ahead.
Bring binoculars and a light layer.

days.title: Morning Chobe game drive
days.travelHack: Morning drives in Chobe catch elephant herds heading to the river — leave at first light.
days.transportationTips: Park entrance and 4x3 pickup from Kasane lodges.
days.localWarnings: Stay in the vehicle except at designated areas.

morning.name: Chobe National Park game drive
morning.description: Renowned elephant density and riverfront game viewing.
bullets: Half- or full-day from Kasane.
Includes park fees on most packages.

afternoon.name: Free afternoon in Kasane
afternoon.description: Pool, river walk, or prep for Victoria Falls tomorrow.
bullets: Check passport for Zimbabwe border crossing.
USD cash useful for visa-on-arrival if required.

evening.name: Dinner in Kasane
evening.description: Riverside or lodge restaurant — early night before Falls day.
bullets: Pack day bag for border crossing.
Confirm pickup time for Falls transfer.

days.title: Victoria Falls day trip
days.travelHack: Organized Kasane→Victoria Falls day trips handle border paperwork — bring passport and visa cash if needed.
days.transportationTips: Road transfer ~1h30 each way via Kazungula border — van or car, not flight.
days.localWarnings: Spray at the falls soaks cameras — use a rain sleeve or dry bag.

morning.name: Road transfer to Victoria Falls
morning.description: Cross at Kazungula and continue to the Zimbabwe side of the falls.
bullets: Operator assists with border formalities.
Carry passport and printed booking.

morning.name: Victoria Falls rainforest walk
morning.description: Main viewpoints along the gorge — thunder, spray, and rainbows.
bullets: Park entry fee paid locally or included.
Rain gear or poncho essential.

afternoon.name: Lunch and optional bridge viewpoint
afternoon.description: Meal in Victoria Falls town; optional look at the bridge or craft market.
bullets: Return transfer mid-afternoon.
Keep border closing times in mind.

evening.name: Return to Kasane
evening.description: Cross back to Botswana and unwind at lodge.
bullets: Long but rewarding day.
Light dinner on arrival.

days.title: Culture and conservation visit
days.travelHack: Snake park and small conservation centres are good rainy-day or slow-day options.

morning.name: Snake park or reptile centre
morning.description: Intro to local snakes and reptiles — educational, not a big-ticket safari.
bullets: Guided handling only where permitted.
1–2 hours is enough.

afternoon.name: Conservation or community project visit
afternoon.description: Short look at anti-poaching or community tourism work around Chobe.
bullets: Book through lodge or local NGO partner.
Donations often welcome.

evening.name: Casual dinner
evening.description: Low-key meal — wind-down before farewell night.
bullets: Optional short river walk at sunset.
Confirm GBE flight for departure day.

days.title: River rest and farewell dinner
days.travelHack: Use this buffer for laundry, souvenirs, and a calm last full day in Botswana.

morning.name: Pool or river relaxation
morning.description: Unstructured morning — you've earned a slow day.
bullets: Optional short curio shopping.
Pack for tomorrow's flights.

afternoon.name: Free afternoon
afternoon.description: Read, nap, or one last riverside photo walk.
bullets: Check international departure from GBE tonight.
Organize documents and boarding passes.

evening.name: Farewell dinner
evening.description: Final Botswana meal — celebrate eighteen days of safari.
bullets: Reserve if dining at a popular lodge restaurant.
Early night — travel tomorrow.

days.title: Domestic hop and international departure
days.travelHack: Kasane→GBE domestic plus evening international — allow buffer for connections; stay airside once checked in.
days.transportationTips: Morning flight Kasane→Gaborone ~1h30. International departure ~17:30 from GBE — arrive ~3h early.
days.localWarnings: Domestic delays happen — don't cut the GBE connection too tight.

morning.name: Domestic flight Kasane to Gaborone
morning.description: Morning hop back to Sir Seretse Khama for international connection.
bullets: Check in luggage through if on one ticket.
Light breakfast before departure.

afternoon.name: GBE layover and check-in
afternoon.description: Transfer to international terminal and clear departure formalities.
bullets: Allow time for security and immigration.
Duty-free is limited — snacks if needed.

evening.name: International departure to Munich
evening.description: Evening flight home after the safari circuit.
bullets: Target airport arrival ~3h before departure.
Departure around 17:30.
